'''Anjan Chowdhury''' ({{langx|bn|অঞ্জন চৌধুরী }}; born 17 July 1954) is a [[Bangladeshi]] industrialist. He is one of the main stakeholders of Square Group, a Bangladeshi business conglomerate engaged in [[pharmaceuticals]], textiles, toiletries & cosmetics, food & beverage, security services, information technology, healthcare, aviation, banking and television broadcasting.

He is recognized by the Government of Bangladesh as a [[Commercially Important Person]] (CIP) for his continuous contribution to the economic development of the country in different years since 2005 and acclaimed as one of the highest taxpayer since 2008.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.newagebd.net/article/85994/48-selected-for-industry-sector-cip-status |title=48 selected for industry sector CIP status |work=New Age}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.daily-sun.com/arcprint/details/424529/182-businessmen-get-CIP-cards/2019-09-19 |title=182 businessmen get CIP cards |work=Daily Sun}}</ref>

==Biography==
Anjan Chowdhury was born on 17 July 1954 as the youngest child of Late [[Samson H. Chowdhury]], the founder of Square Group. He completed his studies from [[University of South Florida]] in Management.<ref name="ds27Feb2020">{{cite news |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/news/midas-reelects-chairman-1873420 |title=MIDAS reelects chairman |work=The Daily Star |date=27 February 2020}}</ref>

He actively participated in The Liberation War of Bangladesh in 1971 as a Freedom Fighter; he was a member of [[Bangladesh Liberation Force]](BLF).<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/news-detail-217234 |title=Samson: a patriot apart |work=The Daily Star}}</ref> He was one of approximately 13,000  trained as commando at the Chakrata, Dehradun cantonment in India during the [[Bangladesh liberation war]].

==Career==
He has been involved with several ventures under the Square Group umbrella, including [[Maasranga Television]], [[Square Toiletries]] Limited, Square Food & Beverages Limited, Square Air Limited, and Mediacom Limited. Over the years, he expanded his business with different ventures known as Sun Communication Limited, VISION Technologies Limited, SUN Technologies Limited, Oracle Travels, Aegis Services Limited and Sun Distribution.<ref name="ds27Feb2020" />

==Association==

Anjan Chowdhury is a Trustee Member of the Education, Science, Technology and Cultural Development Trust (ESTCDT) of [[Independent University, Bangladesh]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.iub.edu.bd/AboutIUB/estcdt |title=Education, Science, Technology and Cultural Development Trust (ESTCDT) |website=Independent University of Bangladesh}}</ref> He is the Chairman of Society for the Promotion of Bangladesh Art (SPBA) and President of Annoda Gobinda Public Library, Pabna.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/126-years-annoda-gobinda-public-library-celebrated-1309993 |work=The Daily Star |title=126 years of Annoda Gobinda Public Library celebrated}}</ref> He is the Vice President of [[Bangladesh Olympic Association]] (BOA) and is a Councilor of [[Bangladesh Football Federation]] (BFF).<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.daily-sun.com/arcprint/details/218515/Bangladesh-Olympic-Association-Election-held/2017-04-10 |title=Bangladesh Olympic Association Election held |work=Daily Sun}}</ref> He is a member of the [[Kurmitola Golf Club]] (KGC) Executive Board.

He served as vice president previously and councilor of [[Bangladesh Cricket Board]], and director of [[Abahani Limited Dhaka]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/uncategorized/2013/08/05/abahani-observe-sk-kamals-birthday-2 |title=Abahani observe Sk Kamal's birthday |work=Dhaka Tribune}}</ref>

==Professional recognitions==

He is the President of AOAB (Aviation Operators Association of Bangladesh).<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.daily-sun.com/printversion/details/259106/Anjan-Chowdhury-elected-presidentof-Aviation-Assoc |title=Anjan Chowdhury elected president of Aviation Assoc |work=Daily Sun}}</ref> He is the President of ATCO ([[Association of Television Channel Owners (ATCO)|Association of Television Channel Owners]]).<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.theindependentbd.com/home/printnews/194428 |title=No ban on foreign TV channels: PM Adviser Salman |work=The Independent |location=Dhaka}}</ref> He is the Chairman of Micro Industries Development Assistance and Services (MIDAS)<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.daily-sun.com/arcprint/details/362448/Anjan-Chowdhury-electedchairman-of-MIDAS/2019-01-08 |title=Anjan Chowdhury elected chairman of MIDAS |work=Daily Sun}}</ref> and Dmoney.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/business/dmoney-digital-payment-service-platform-starts-commercial-operation-1807735 |title=Digital platform Dmoney starts commercial operation |work=The Daily Star}}</ref> He is also the Chairman of Sun Foundation and Sun Communications Ltd.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.unb.com.bd/category/lifestyle/dhaka-international-folk-fest-underway/6529 |title=Dhaka International Folk Fest Underway |work=UNB}}</ref>

He was the former president of BAPA (Bangladesh Agro Processors Association) and Bangladesh Toiletries and Cosmetic Association.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://archive.thedailystar.net/2004/09/29/d40929050354.htm |title=Three-day cosmetics show begins tomorrow |work=The Daily Star}}</ref>

== Contributions in sports, culture and education ==

===Sports===
Chowdhury is associated with various sports councils, associations, clubs, etc. and he is honored with lifetime membership of Bangladesh Sports Press Association (BSPA). He was a member of the Pabna District Sports Association's executive committee and still conducts their events as a consultant. He has been awarded the [[National Sports Awards]] 2009 by The Ministry of Youth & Sports, Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/news-detail-142719|date=2010-06-15|access-date=2025-01-28|title=National Sports Awards given |work=The Daily Star}}</ref> He is the founding chairman of Pabna Pirates FC (Football Club) and Pabna Pirates CC (Cricket Club). He was the former president of Pabna Press Club. He also served as the vice-president of the [[Bangladesh Football Federation]] (BFF).<ref>{{cite news |title=Heavy football menu on heat|url=https://www.thedailystar.net/news/heavy-football-menu-on-heat|newspaper=The Daily Star|date=1999-01-17|access-date=2025-01-28|archive-date=2025-01-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250128164803/https://www.thedailystar.net/news/heavy-football-menu-on-heat|url-status=live}}</ref>

===Film===
He won the 34th [[National Film Awards (Bangladesh)]] as Best Producer in the year 2011 by the Ministry of Culture, Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh for the feature film "[[Monpura]]."<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/news-detail-195609 |title='Ganga Jatra' and 'Monpura' shine |work=The Daily Star}}</ref> He repeated his success at the 45th National Film Award for the film "[[Bishwoshundori]]" released in 2020 under his production company Sun Music and Motion Pictures Ltd.<ref>{{Cite news |title='Bishwoshundori' released digitally on Friday |url=https://www.daily-sun.com/post/553852/%E2%80%98Bishwoshundori%E2%80%99-released-digitally-on-Friday |work=Daily Sun}}</ref> He won the Best Producer award along with awards in 7 more categories.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-23 |title=Anjan Chowdhury Pintu again won the National Film Award - Stream TV Pro |url=https://streamtvpro.co/entertainment/anjan-chowdhury-pintu-again-won-the-national-film-award/}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-02-15 |title=Winners of National Film Awards 2020 announced |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/entertainment/tv-film/news/winners-national-film-awards-2020-announced-2962736 |work=The Daily Star}}</ref>

In 2022, He produced mystery-drama [[Hawa (2022 Bangladeshi film)|Hawa]] under Sun Music and Motion Pictures Ltd.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-07-26 |title=Of unreleased tracks and untold stories: Team 'Hawa' visits BUET |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/entertainment/tv-film/news/unreleased-tracks-and-untold-stories-team-hawa-visits-buet-3079766 |access-date=2022-08-31 |work=The Daily Star |language=en}}</ref> [[Hawa (2022 Bangladeshi film)|Hawa]] is hugely acclaimed both critically and commercially.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Hawa: The game changer |url=https://thefinancialexpress.com.bd/entertainment/hawa-the-game-changer-1659530738 |work=The Financial Express}}</ref>

=== Education ===
He is one of the founders of the Dishari Computer Training Institute that engages the poor and meritorious students in the development of skills.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://samakal.com/print/140133582/print |script-title=bn:দিশারী কম্পিউটার কোর্সের সনদ বিতরণ |work=Samakal |language=bn}}</ref> He contributed to the renovation of the Public Library of Annoda Gobinda and Bonomali Shilpakala Kendra.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/bonomali-shilpakala-kendra-reopens-in-pabna-59286 |title=Bonomali Shilpakala Kendra reopens in Pabna |work=The Daily Star}}</ref> He initiated and contributed to ASTRAS, Poura Prathomik Biddaloy, Square Kindergarten, Square High School & College being founded, he is also involved in projects specifically focused on sustainable economy and educational development for the underprivileged.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.jugantor.com/todays-paper/sports/138459/%E0%A6%AA%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%AC%E0%A6%A8%E0%A6%BE%E0%A7%9F-%E0%A6%B8%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%95%E0%A7%9F%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B0-%E0%A6%B8%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%95%E0%A7%81%E0%A6%B2-%E0%A6%93-%E0%A6%95%E0%A6%B2%E0%A7%87%E0%A6%9C%E0%A7%87%E0%A6%B0-%E0%A6%B6%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%95%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%B7%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B0%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%A5%E0%A7%80%E0%A6%A6%E0%A7%87%E0%A6%B0-%E0%A6%95%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%B0%E0%A7%80%E0%A7%9C%E0%A6%BE%E0%A7%9F-%E0%A6%AE%E0%A7%81%E0%A6%97%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%A7-%E0%A6%AC%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%B0%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%9C%E0%A6%BF%E0%A6%B2-%E0%A6%AD%E0%A7%81%E0%A6%9F%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%A8%E0%A7%87%E0%A6%B0-%E0%A6%B0%E0%A6%BE%E0%A6%B7%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%9F%E0%A7%8D%E0%A6%B0%E0%A6%A6%E0%A7%82%E0%A6%A4 |script-title=bn:পাবনায় স্কয়ার স্কুল ও কলেজের শিক্ষার্থীদের ক্রীড়ায় মুগ্ধ ব্রাজিল ভুটানের রাষ্ট্রদূত |work=Jugantor |language=bn}}</ref>

===Music===
He has organized an international folk music platform called "Dhaka International Folk Fest" since 2015  and “Magic Bauliana”, a talent show aimed at finding new talents in folk music.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://m.theindependentbd.com/printversion/details/220772 |title=Fifth edition of 'Dhaka Int'l Folk Fest' set to begin Nov 14 |work=The Independent |location=Dhaka}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/registration-magic-bauliana-2019-underway-1799026 |title=Registration for ‘Magic Bauliana 2019' underway |work=The Daily Star}}</ref>

===Women empowerment===
He is a member of the WINGs (women in need group) advisory board. In cooperation with The Government of The Netherlands and [[SNV Netherlands Development Organisation]], he had helped female RMG workers in Bangladesh to ensure their [[sexual and reproductive health and rights]] (SRHR). He is a current member of American Embassy Employees’ Association, Dhaka.

===Food industry===
To promote Bangladeshi cuisine and give local cooks a head-start in the food industry, he has initiated reality show “[[Shera Radhuni]]” which highlights the rich history and techniques of Bangladeshi recipes.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.theindependentbd.com/post/16936 |title='Sera Radhuni 1422' set to start in new manner |work=The Independent |location=Dhaka}}</ref>

==Dhaka International Folk Fest==
Dhaka International Folk Fest is a musical genius celebration where numerous folk artists from home and abroad perform on a single stage. It is a popular three-day folk music celebration. This show is on a journey to globally promote folk music and to introduce the world of folk music to the Bangladeshi people.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/dhaka-international-folk-fest-2019-open-november-14-1817809 |title=Dhaka International Folk Fest 2019 to open on November 14 |work=The Daily Star}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.dhakatribune.com/showtime/2019/11/15/5th-dhaka-international-folk-fest-diff-kicks-off-with-versatile-performances |title=5th Dhaka International Folk Fest (DIFF) kicks off with versatile performances |work=Dhaka Tribune}}</ref>
